_comment: Phase 167.1.1.1 (BRIDGERETURNS) D-03, SC3. The cross-runtime oracle for the SPOT mark-price rule. Read by analytics-service/tests/test_holding_marks_fixture.py (classify_spot_marks) and src/app/(dashboard)/compare/lib/holding-compare-adapter.test.ts (classifySpotMarks, fetchHoldingCompareItem). HAND-TYPED: every expected figure was worked out by hand from the case's own marks (the arithmetic is in each case's why), never produced by either implementation. The rule: one mark per UTC day from the row with the latest updated_at instant, ties to the smallest LOWERCASE api_key_id; a finite mark at or below 0 is a gap skipped BEFORE that pick; a return exists only between two ADJACENT calendar days that both carry a mark, keyed by the LATER day; a spot holding needs min_priced_days priced days; the withheld ladder is account_balance, fixed_price (marks not read), then the read contract, then no_price, then too_few_priced_days. ts maps a case onto what /compare shows. Do not add a case here without both runtimes consuming it; the two suites read this file whole.

cases.name: purchase_at_constant_mark
cases.why: SC1: the mark never moves while the quantity and the dollar value do; the dollar-ratio read printed +100% and -75%, the price rule must print exactly 0.
